title: Fictional handout assembly rehearsal notes
provenance: Invented classroom planning data, not a real experiment, vendor benchmark or production metric.
scope: One scripted rehearsal per workflow, assembling 40 handout sets in each rehearsal.

decision_rule.text: A workflow is eligible for the next rehearsal only if at most 2 of its 40 sets are mislabelled; among eligible workflows prefer shorter preparation time.

qualification: These are single scripted runs. Operator learning and a repeat-run distribution are not supplied.
proposal: Use Tray for the next rehearsal and repeat both workflows before adopting a standing process. No purchase or deployment is authorized.
